phase_goal: complete a Codex-only controlled pilot for target-change consumer alignment and rg absence guard hardening
entry_conditions: current worktree contains target-change/rg absence readiness findings and user-authorized pilot plan
exit_conditions: targeted gates, context contract, readiness validator, and quick gate pass without full gate

unit_priority_order.priority_basis: single low-risk pilot unit covers both target-change consumer alignment and rg absence guard hardening

locked_fields.phase_goal: complete a Codex-only controlled pilot for target-change consumer alignment and rg absence guard hardening
entry_conditions: current worktree contains target-change/rg absence readiness findings and user-authorized pilot plan
exit_conditions: targeted gates, context contract, readiness validator, and quick gate pass without full gate

as_is_flows.trigger: standard-chain readiness review finds target-change consumer drift and rg absence guard weakness
steps: operator inspects the target-chain readiness findings
operator confirms fixes are repository-local, low risk, and reversible
delivery owner needs canonical evidence before declaring controlled pilot readiness
as_is_flows.observed_state: Mechanism-level gates can pass while actual pilot artifacts still need canonical closure.
pain_points: fixture-only evidence could be mistaken for an actual controlled pilot
unlocked target-change consumers or rg search failures can create false readiness signals

to_be_flows.trigger: user authorizes Codex to execute the controlled pilot plan
steps: operator records the real low-risk demand in canonical artifacts
implementation locks target-change consumers and fail-closed rg absence checks
delivery owner closes signoff only after targeted gates, context recovery, readiness validation, and quick regression pass
to_be_flows.expected_outcome: actual Codex-only controlled pilot reaches ALLOW with signed user decision and no target-in-scope P0/P1 blockers
branch_coverage: target-change consumer drift is blocked by contract and validator checks
rg absence search errors fail closed instead of passing as absence
full gate remains excluded by user constraint and is reported as unrun rather than claimed

nodes.label: User-authorized controlled pilot demand is recorded
Targeted contract fixes and rg absence guard fixes are proven
Delivery owner signs off with current runtime evidence

edges.condition: UNIT acceptance criteria are mapped to tasks
readiness, context, targeted, and quick gates pass

feature_inventory.capability: controlled pilot closure for standard-chain readiness fixes
feature_inventory.actor_or_scenario: Codex operator runs a repository-local low-risk demand through the full standard-chain evidence path.
feature_inventory.core_behavior: Canonical artifacts trace target-change contract alignment and rg absence hardening through implementation, verification, review, QA, signoff, and user decision.
feature_inventory.observable_result: readiness validator accepts the actual pilot phase and signoff-package records ALLOW/SIGNED_OFF

module_capability_matrix.capability: guard target-change consumer consistency and rg absence failure semantics
protected_behaviors: Do not treat fixture-only regression as actual pilot completion.
Do not run or claim full gate under the current user constraint.

entry_scene_inventory.scenario: Repository-local Codex-only pilot validates the standard-chain can close a real low-risk demand.

business_objects.definition: A user-authorized low-risk repository-local demand that exercises canonical chain closure from brief to signoff.

state_transitions.trigger: targeted fixes and actual pilot artifacts are produced
state_transitions.observable_result: delivery-state is CLOSED and signoff-package is ALLOW/SIGNED_OFF

permissions: modify repository-local contracts, validators, tests, and pilot docs within the agreed scope

risk_ledger.source: standard-chain readiness review and controlled pilot scope decision
risk_ledger.trigger_condition: fixture-only evidence, stale target-change refs, or rg search errors are accepted as proof
risk_ledger.impact: Team pilot could start with a chain that cannot reliably block drift or recover current state.
risk_ledger.pm_decision: Require actual pilot canonical artifacts plus targeted gates, readiness validation, context recovery validation, and quick regression.
risk_ledger.mitigation_or_owner: Codex operator closes in-scope evidence; delivery owner reports full gate exclusion as an explicit constraint.
risk_ledger.verification_target: signoff-package.runtime_evidence_matrix, user-decision, readiness validator, and targeted proving commands

review_conclusion.summary: phase PRD is closed for the actual controlled pilot demand

business_flows: user-authorized pilot demand -> canonical phase artifacts -> targeted implementation evidence -> delivery-owner signoff -> user decision
user_paths: Codex operator completes a real low-risk repository-local standard-chain demand and recovers current state from active-doc-scope/worklog.
rule_mappings: target-change stale evidence must be explicitly invalidated or consumed by consistency-auditor
rg absence gates must fail closed on search errors
completion claims must separate quick/targeted evidence from unrun full gate

coverage_matrix.action_or_path: target-change catalog, chain consumer, field-consumption, and matrix contracts remain aligned
standard-chain shell absence checks reject rg search errors instead of treating them as absence

technical_evidence_requirements.business_invariant: target-change artifact definitions, consumers, and field-level gate consumers must not drift across standard-chain contracts and validators
technical_evidence_requirements.required_downstream_proof: targeted contract tests must fail when target-change catalog entries or consistency-auditor consumers are missing

technical_evidence_requirements.business_invariant: absence checks must distinguish no match from search failure before using the result as readiness evidence
technical_evidence_requirements.required_downstream_proof: targeted shell gates must use assert_rg_no_match or equivalent exit-status handling and pass under current rg availability

supported_platforms: Codex CLI controlled pilot in this repository
unsupported_platforms: broad team rollout before a separate broader runtime dogfood
full-gate completion claim under the current user constraint

residual_risks.description: Full gate was intentionally not run because the user constrained this task to quick and targeted gates.
residual_risks.target_resolution: record as out-of-scope verification gap for later broad rollout decision, not as a controlled-pilot blocker
